newsitem.title: TURKEY: Iraq Kurd group says pushes rival, kills 73.
newsitem.headline: Iraq Kurd group says pushes rival, kills 73.

text.p: An Iraqi Kurdish group that lost several areas in northern Iraq to its rival last month said on Saturday it had regained some towns after a fresh attack.

The Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK), led by Jalal Talabani, said in a statement that its forces killed more than 73 members of the Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP), led by Massoud Barzani, who last month took control of the whole region with backing from Baghdad.
There was no immediate independent confirmation.

The PUK said that on Friday it "liberated" nine towns in the Sulaimaniya province in northern Iraq. The city of Sulaimaniya had been the PUK's stronghold until the fighting that broke out on August 31 and forced PUK forces to retreat to areas along the Iranian border.
